manifest: R0 bridge-affinity input — LOCKED before WP-R0-CODE runs (anti-improvisation / anti-circularity)
manifest_note: Pre-run TEMPLATE. Numeric affinity values + several edge_type classifications are 'TODO-on-fetch' (same convention as the other data/manifests/*.json templates). This file enumerates EVERY allowed external Hubble route, EVERY allowed pairwise edge, the LOCKED spanning tree, and the candidate held-out cycles BEFORE the run, so R0-B cannot build whatever graph is available after looking at the data. WP-R0-CODE MUST read + sha256-stamp this file before constructing any route graph, and may use ONLY the routes/edges/cycles listed here with their declared eligibility, edge_type, and shared-anchor exclusions. Validated by tests/test_r0_manifest.py.
edge_type_policy: Every edge carries edge_type ∈ {direct_cross_calibration, route_readout_difference, TODO-on-fetch-classify}. ONLY edge_type=direct_cross_calibration edges may be DECISIVE held-out edges in R0-B. A 'direct_cross_calibration' is a genuine differential measurement on SHARED data (e.g. two ladders on common host galaxies / common JWST fields) that is NOT reducible to an H0 difference. A 'route_readout_difference' (a(r,r')=Phi(r')-Phi(r), i.e. H0_i - H0_j) is an EXACT 1-form / node-potential difference ⇒ A_gamma==0 by NG_FORCE_NULL ⇒ FORBIDDEN as a decisive held-out edge (R0 §3.2 exact-form no-go). 'TODO-on-fetch-classify' edges MUST be classified at fetch time and, if route_readout_difference, are demoted to non-decisive (R0-A only).
anti_circularity_rule: No DECISIVE held-out edge may share a calibration anchor (anchor_family / shares_anchor_with) with any spanning-tree edge that determines its node potentials. The spanning tree is fit on tree edges only; A_gamma is scored on the held-out test edges. A cycle is DECISIVE-eligible iff ALL its held-out edges are (a) edge_type=direct_cross_calibration, (b) eligible_for_test_cycle=true, and (c) anchor-disjoint from every tree_path edge in that cycle.
orientation_convention: Pre-register the per-edge i->j orientation BEFORE any cycle is scored. For a cycle, A_gamma = (oriented sum of held-out edge affinities) + (oriented sum of tree_path edge affinities) around the closed loop; equivalently A_gamma = sum_{heldout}(a) - [tree node-potential difference between the held-out edges' endpoints]. Under an exact form A_gamma==0 identically.
